'''2003 Origins''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Columbus, Ohio (June 2003). Its Star Wars CCG main event was the Origins 2003 DPC Championship, the second event of the Players Committee and DeckTech's DPC Championship Series, played on Saturday 28 June 2003 at the Greater Columbus Convention Center; [[Andrew Howard]] directed it, and [[Joe Giannetti|Joseph Giannetti]] and [[Matt Scott]] qualified for Day 2 of the [[2003 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-events03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20031009215036/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/events.htm 2003 Events], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 9 October 2003.</ref><ref name="pc-origins03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030605060430/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/origins05212003.htm SWCCG Player's Committee @ Origins 2003], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 5 June 2003.</ref> The winner was promised $500, with cash for the rest of the top 4 and a virtual card design for 2nd place.<ref name="pc-origins03" /> On Friday 27 June at 6 PM the Committee and DeckTech staged a "Grudge Match" between the #1 and #2 rated players in the world, [[Brian Hunter]] and [[Hayes Hunter]]; its result has not been found.<ref name="pc-jun03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20031016172417/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/june03archives.htm June 03 Updates], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 16 October 2003.</ref> Decklists below were recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS5]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Columbus, Ohio
* '''Dates:''' 27–28 June 2003 (DPC Championship 28 June)<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Venue:''' Greater Columbus Convention Center<ref name="pc-events03" />
* '''Day 2 qualifiers:''' [[Joe Giannetti|Joseph Giannetti]], [[Matt Scott]]<ref name="pc-events03" />
